title: Femoral hernia: anatomy and surgical consequence

header.contentArea: Surgical anatomy: femoral canal and femoral hernia

brief.scenario: A patient has a tender irreducible groin lump below and lateral to the pubic tubercle.
brief.task: Describe the femoral canal and femoral ring, explain the likely hernia and identify the surgical risks. You have 9 minutes. The examiner will ask questions.

beforeYouWalkIn.frame: Know the ring, know the vein, know the strangulation risk.
beforeYouWalkIn.trap: Treating a painful irreducible femoral hernia as one to watch.
beforeYouWalkIn.firstMove: Say this is a likely femoral hernia that needs same-day emergency surgical assessment and repair, then give the anatomy.

flow: Name the likely hernia from its position
Describe the sheath, canal and ring

grid.label: Femoral canal and sheath
grid.fail: Confuses the femoral canal with the inguinal canal or the femoral vein.
grid.pass: The canal is the medial compartment of the femoral sheath, medial to the femoral vein, containing lymphatic tissue.
grid.high: Explains the canal lets the femoral vein expand, which is why it is a potential space and a hernia route.

grid.label: Boundaries of the femoral ring
grid.fail: Confuses the pectineal and lacunar ligaments, or cannot name the boundaries.
grid.pass: Anterior: inguinal ligament. Posterior: pectineal ligament over the superior pubic ramus, with pectineus posteriorly. Medial: lacunar ligament. Lateral: femoral vein.
grid.high: Explains that three unyielding ligamentous boundaries make the neck narrow and rigid.

grid.label: Order of structures
grid.fail: Recites a mnemonic with an “empty space” and places the nerve inside the sheath.
grid.pass: From lateral to medial: femoral nerve, artery, vein, then femoral canal containing lymphatic tissue.
grid.high: The nerve lies outside the femoral sheath; the canal is not literally empty.

grid.label: Locates the hernia
grid.fail: Places a femoral hernia above and medial to the pubic tubercle.
grid.pass: Below and lateral to the pubic tubercle.
grid.high: Notes the sac can turn up over the inguinal ligament, so its neck, not the bulk, decides the type.

grid.label: Recognises the emergency
grid.fail: Offers watchful waiting, or waits for vomiting or obstruction before acting.
grid.pass: Tender irreducible femoral hernia: same-day emergency surgical assessment and repair, whether or not there is vomiting or obstruction.
grid.high: Explains femoral hernias can strangulate without obstruction (Richter's); nil by mouth, IV access, analgesia, calls the senior surgeon.

grid.label: Operative anatomy
grid.fail: Unaware of the femoral vein laterally during repair.
grid.pass: Protects the femoral vein laterally when closing the canal and checks the viability of any trapped bowel.
grid.high: Notes an abnormal obturator artery may lie near the lacunar ligament if it is divided to release a tight neck.

fail.speaker: candidate
fail.text: Above and medial to the pubic tubercle, so it is an inguinal hernia.

fail.speaker: candidate
fail.text: It is the space that contains the femoral vein.

fail.speaker: examiner
fail.text: What are the boundaries of the femoral ring?

fail.speaker: candidate
fail.text: The lacunar ligament behind and the pectineal ligament medially.

fail.speaker: examiner
fail.text: What is the order of structures?

fail.speaker: candidate
fail.text: NAVEL: nerve, artery, vein, empty space, lymphatics, all inside the sheath.

fail.speaker: examiner
fail.text: It is tender and irreducible. What would you do?

fail.speaker: candidate
fail.text: I would book it for an elective repair and see him in clinic.

fail.speaker: examiner
fail.text: What structure is at risk when you repair it?

fail.speaker: candidate
fail.text: The femoral nerve, which is medial to the canal.

pass.speaker: candidate
pass.text: Below and lateral to the pubic tubercle, which fits a femoral hernia.

pass.speaker: candidate
pass.text: The femoral canal lies medial to the femoral vein within the femoral sheath. It is the medial compartment and contains lymphatic tissue.

pass.speaker: examiner
pass.text: What are the boundaries of the femoral ring?

pass.speaker: candidate
pass.text: Anteriorly the inguinal ligament; posteriorly the pectineal ligament over the superior pubic ramus, with pectineus posteriorly; medially the lacunar ligament; laterally the femoral vein.

pass.speaker: candidate
pass.text: From lateral to medial: femoral nerve, artery, vein, then femoral canal containing lymphatic tissue.

pass.speaker: examiner
pass.text: It is tender and irreducible. What would you do?

pass.speaker: candidate
pass.text: A tender irreducible femoral hernia needs same-day emergency surgical assessment and repair whether or not there is vomiting or obstruction, because femoral hernias can strangulate without obstruction. I would not offer watchful waiting.

pass.speaker: candidate
pass.text: At repair I would protect the femoral vein laterally and check any trapped bowel is viable.

high.speaker: candidate
high.text: Below and lateral to the pubic tubercle. The sac can turn up over the inguinal ligament, so I judge by where the neck lies.

high.speaker: candidate
high.text: It is the medial compartment of the femoral sheath. It lets the femoral vein expand, which is why it is a potential space and a route for a hernia.

high.speaker: candidate
high.text: Three of its four boundaries are ligaments, so the neck is narrow and rigid. That explains the high risk of incarceration and strangulation.

high.speaker: candidate
high.text: From lateral to medial: femoral nerve, artery, vein, then femoral canal containing lymphatic tissue. The nerve lies outside the femoral sheath; the canal is not literally empty.

high.speaker: examiner
high.text: It is tender and irreducible. What would you do?

high.speaker: candidate
high.text: A tender irreducible femoral hernia needs same-day emergency surgical assessment and repair whether or not there is vomiting or obstruction, because femoral hernias can strangulate without obstruction. A Richter's hernia can strangulate with no vomiting at all, so I would not wait for it. I would keep him nil by mouth, site IV access, give analgesia and call the registrar.

high.speaker: candidate
high.text: If the neck has to be released medially, an abnormal obturator artery can lie close to the lacunar ligament, so I would be aware of it. The femoral vein is protected laterally.

failures.move: Offers watchful waiting or an elective list for a painful irreducible femoral hernia.
failures.consequence: Strangulated bowel may be missed. This is a critical fail.

failures.move: Swaps the pectineal and lacunar ligaments.
failures.consequence: The anatomy of the narrow neck is wrong.

failures.move: Places the femoral nerve inside the sheath.

knowledge.fact: Femoral ring: inguinal ligament in front; pectineal ligament over the superior pubic ramus, with pectineus, behind; lacunar ligament medially; femoral vein laterally.
A femoral hernia lies below and lateral to the pubic tubercle; its narrow rigid neck explains the strangulation risk. Watchful waiting is discouraged.

A tender irreducible femoral hernia needs same-day emergency surgical assessment and repair whether or not there is vomiting or obstruction, because femoral hernias can strangulate without obstruction.

recall.think: Strangulated bowel in a narrow, rigid neck.
recall.say: “A tender irreducible femoral hernia needs same-day emergency surgical assessment and repair.”
do: Nil by mouth, IV access, analgesia
Same-day emergency surgical assessment: do not wait for vomiting or obstruction

numbers.meaning: inguinal, pectineal and lacunar ligaments, femoral vein

recall.trap: Calling a groin lump inguinal without placing it against the pubic tubercle.
recall.finish: Same-day emergency repair with assessment of bowel viability.

sources.name: Stabilini C, van Veenendaal N, Aasvang E, et al. Update of the international HerniaSurge guidelines for groin hernia management. BJS Open 2023;7(5):zrad080
sources.supports: Acutely irreducible groin hernia is a potentially life-threatening emergency needing urgent surgical attention; emergency surgery immediately when strangulation is diagnosed or manual reduction fails; femoral type predicts bowel resection.

sources.name: HerniaSurge Group. International guidelines for groin hernia management. Hernia 2018;22(1):1–165
sources.supports: Femoral hernias carry a higher risk of incarceration and strangulation than inguinal hernias; watchful waiting is discouraged; timely repair is recommended for all femoral hernias.

sources.name: Standring S (ed). Gray's Anatomy: The Anatomical Basis of Clinical Practice

push.question: Where is the swelling relative to the pubic tubercle, and what does that suggest?
What structure is immediately lateral to the femoral canal?
What are you careful of at repair?

curveballs.prompt: He is due on an elective list next month. Can he wait?
curveballs.safeAnswer: No. A tender irreducible femoral hernia needs same-day emergency surgical assessment and repair whether or not there is vomiting or obstruction, because femoral hernias can strangulate without obstruction.
